pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any pickaxe. The actual pickaxe keeps its wear, name, and enchantments.

Starts waiting. Select Mine to excavate the release chunk downward, preserving stairs. Wood, leaves, containers, and unbreakable blocks stay intact. Equip a pickaxe and shovel, and carry repair blocks. Full cargo, missing tools, exhaustion, or protection can pause work.

The held tool determines normal speed and drops. Work Speed only boosts an effective tool: a pickaxe on dirt stays slow without a shovel. Ore tool tiers cannot be bypassed. See $(l:fieldwork/fluids)Fluids$() and $(l:cooperation/shared_quarry)Shared stairs$(). Mending uses ore experience to repair the working tool before leftover orbs spawn.
